title: Move a little every day
summary: Adults are generally advised to aim for about 150 minutes of moderate activity a week, such as brisk walking. Short walks after meals count.

title: Keep a steady sleep routine
summary: Most adults do best with 7 to 9 hours of sleep. Going to bed and waking up at similar times, even on weekends, helps your body clock.

title: Fill half your plate with plants
summary: Vegetables, fruit, pulses and whole grains give fibre and nutrients. Try adding one extra portion of vegetables to a meal each day.

title: Go easy on salt and sugary drinks
summary: Too much salt can raise blood pressure, and sugary drinks add calories without filling you up. Water is a simple swap.

title: Wash your hands properly
summary: Wash with soap and water for about 20 seconds, especially before eating and after using the toilet. It lowers the spread of many infections.

title: Brush twice a day
summary: Brush for two minutes, morning and night, with fluoride toothpaste. Clean between your teeth daily and visit a dentist for regular check-ups.

title: Take short breaks from screens
summary: Pause every hour to stretch and look at something far away. Regular breaks ease tired eyes and a stiff neck.

title: Talk about stress early
summary: Sharing worries with a friend, family member or professional can help. Reach out for support if low mood or anxiety lasts for weeks.

title: Know your numbers
summary: Blood pressure and cholesterol often show no symptoms. Regular check-ups let a doctor spot changes early.

title: Know when to seek urgent help
summary: Chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden weakness or confusion need emergency care straight away. Do not wait for an appointment.
